meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能替你操作浏览器：打开网址、点击或填写表单、截图、保存 PDF、提取网页内容。它会先获取页面上的可交互元素，再按指令操作并核对结果。
howto.when: 当你的请求涉及打开网页、填写表单、截图等浏览器操作时触发。

say.note: 会打开网址并生成截图文件。

say.text: 在登录页面帮我填写邮箱和密码并点击登录
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填写、点击。

say.text: 把当前网页保存成 PDF
say.note: 将当前页面导出为 PDF 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate a browser for you: open pages, click or fill forms, take screenshots, save PDFs, and extract content. It first inspects interactive elements, then acts and verifies results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your request involves browser actions such as opening pages, filling forms, or taking screenshots.

say_en.text: Open example.com, take a screenshot and save it.
say_en.note: Opens the URL and generates a screenshot file.

say_en.text: On the login page, fill in my email and password and click Login.
say_en.note: Claude locates fields, fills them, and clicks.

say_en.text: Save the current page as a PDF.
say_en.note: Exports the page to a PDF file.
